sources.observed: POST /library/{libraryId}/videos with Stream AccessKey and title creates a video and returns libraryID/GUID/title. No client idempotency token documented; adapter persists intent and reconciles exact title instead.

PUT /library/{libraryId}/videos/{videoId}, application/octet-stream, raw file; successful response includes success. Transcription and smart generation flags can incur separate changes/charges, so explicitly disabled.
GET supports page/itemsPerPage/search; title search is case-insensitive substring, so exact-title filtering and bounded complete pagination are necessary.

GET returns videoLibraryId/GUID/title, processing metadata and originalHash described as original uploaded file SHA256. Exact source proof is separate from transfer acknowledgment and native playback.

fallback: Followed current official documentation links from the successfully opened Get Video page. No third-party API descriptions used for implementation.
